hypothesis: next_offsets cloned and hashed a TopicPartition string for every record. Keying the scan by a borrowed topic and partition id removes that per-record clone.
host: Intel Xeon (family 6 model 207), 4 cores, Ubuntu 24.04, rustc 1.99.0, cargo test --release

primary.metric: nanoseconds for 40 calls of next_offsets on 60000 records across 6 partitions

results.correctness: First-seen order and the last record's leader epoch match, including a partition that reappears after another partition.

limits: The comparison ran the previous algorithm and the new one back to back in one release test process, then the timing test was removed.
nb-fetch-bulk was not re-run. The measured work is next_offsets itself.
